## Global rules for the appendices M–Q (the former appendix-draft §00; binding for App M–Q)

### 00.1 Units, files, budgets (lead-author decision)

| unit | key | file | 中文标题 (binding) | pp | writer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| M | `appM` | `appM_ope.tex` | OPE：微扰证明、无质量 QCD、非微扰条件定理 | 24 | one writer (recommended: the Ch7 `dis` writer, after Ch7 statements are frozen) |
| N | `appN` | `appN_subtraction.tex` | Collins 减除法的精确形式 | 24 | one writer (recommended: also writes Ch9 `sec:method-subtraction`) — written **first** among M/N/O |
| O | `appO` | `appO_glauber.tex` | 光锥排序微扰论与 Drell–Yan 的 Glauber 相消 | 32 | one writer after the App N labels of §N.3–§N.5 are frozen (recommended: also writes Ch12 `sec:dy-glauber`, `sec:dy-model`, `sec:dy-theorem`) |
| P | `appP` | `appP_blueprint.tex` | 形式化蓝图：假设登记表、依赖图与状态表——由 \uses 数据自动生成 + 导言 | 10 | introduction by a writer (≈2 pp, last); tables and figures generated by the integrator |
| Q | `appQ` | `appQ_errata.tex` | 经核实的文献勘误 | 4 | written after `verify/` completes |

Labels: appendix `\label{app:appM}` … `\label{app:appQ}`; sections `sec:appM-…`; statements `def|asm|lem|prop|thm|cor|ex|rem:appM-…`; tables `tab:appM-…`; figures as in FIGURES_INDEX_v2. Chapter-owned statements whose proofs are delivered here keep their chapter labels (WRITER_SPEC_v2 §5.3, §6.3); they are listed in the **proof-delivery table** of each appendix and are **not** in the registry of the appendix.

### 00.2 How each entry is written (in addition to WRITER_SPEC_v2 §4, §6)

1. **Entry format.** `**类型 `label` — 中文标题** [tag, qualifier]` · premise sentence (R_cond) · partonic/non-perturbative line · *Statement* (formulas in the binding conventions) · `\uses{…}` · *Proof plan* (full / sketch; numbered steps; literature with location; checks with script paths) · *VF* IDs · *Error type* of the conclusion (WRITER_SPEC_v2 §4.7) · *Surpass/correction* note (ERR IDs refer to `refdoc/REFDOC_ANALYSIS.md` §2; never printed).
2. **Partonic line.** Every App N and App O statement concerns partonic integrands order by order; its hypotheses end with 「（本命题只涉及部分子态。）」. App M §M.2–§M.7 likewise (massive models, partonic Green functions). App M §M.8 is hadronic: its R_cond statements list `asm:intro-*` in the premise sentence and end with 「非微扰地位：见前提（MA0、MA3、MA4）。」.
3. **Qualifier sentences** are the verbatim strings of WRITER_SPEC_v2 §4.3; the R_cond premise sentence 「前提：\cref{asm:…}、…」 lists every assumption and every non-[R] statement used, and the same labels are in `\uses`.
4. **`\uses` order inside one appendix file.** A label may be used only after it is defined in the same file (check C4). The order of the entries below respects this; writers keep it. Appendix statements may use statements of any chapter and of other appendices (no cycles; App P checks).
5. **Chapter statements proved here.** The appendix section starts with 「\cref{…} 的证明」; the statement is not repeated as an environment. The restatement given in this outline (marked *Target*) is for the appendix writer only; if it differs from the chapter's wording in `FINAL_OUTLINE_v2`, the chapter wording governs and the writer reports the difference. The chapter statement's `\uses` must contain the appendix lemmas its proof uses; the column "appendix lemmas for the chapter `\uses`" of the proof-delivery tables gives them (for the merge into the core outline).
6. **The reference document** is never cited, quoted or named (WRITER_SPEC_v2 §6.10). Internal identifiers such as "Thm D.10", "Ass. E.33" appear in this outline only for traceability. Every adopted construction is re-derived and attributed to the primary literature (Zimmermann; Lowenstein–Zimmermann; Joglekar–Lee; Weinberg; Collins 2011; Collins–Soper–Sterman; Bodwin; Aybat–Sterman; Diehl–Gaunt–Ostermeier–Plößl–Schäfer; Kogut–Soper; Veltman; Rothstein–Stewart; …) or presented as our derivation.
7. **Error types.** Each status table (`tab:appM-status`, `tab:appN-status`, `tab:appO-checklist`) has the column 「误差类型」 with E-S / E-P / E-F / E-N / E-N$^\varphi$ (fibered integral norm, `def:appN-fibered`; v2.3) / E-W, and each `proofsketch` step that rests on power counting names its type.
8. **Box** 「本附录证明了什么／没有证明什么」 right after the first paragraph of App M, N, O (WRITER_SPEC_v2 §6.6 frame; labels only). Drafts are given below.
9. **Conventions.** Light-cone vectors $n_A=(1^+,0^-,\mathbf 0_T)$, $n_B=(0^+,1^-,\mathbf 0_T)$ (row 2), never $n,\bar n$ (the reference's $n,\bar n$ are our $n_A,n_B$). Projections $\pi_+(k)=(n_B\cdot k)\,n_A=(k^+,0,\mathbf 0_T)$, $\pi_-(k)=(n_A\cdot k)\,n_B=(0,k^-,\mathbf 0_T)$. Glauber direction $e_G=n_B-n_A$ (row 38, VF-REF-7). Eikonal rules VF-WL-1 (row 28): past-pointing $W[0,-\infty n]$: $\prod_j\frac{i}{n\cdot(k_1+\dots+k_j)+i0}$; future-pointing $W[\infty n,0]$: $\prod_j\frac{-i}{n\cdot(k_j+\dots+k_m)-i0}$. Coupling $D_\mu=\partial_\mu-igA_\mu^at^a$, quark–gluon vertex $+ig\gamma^\mu t^a$ (the reference's "$-igJ^{+a}$" is a sign slip, ERR-m26).

### 00.3 Tag policy for the technical assumptions (consistency with the grade-propagation rule)

The grade-propagation rule (WRITER_SPEC_v2 §4.6) makes every process theorem carry at most the weakest tag of the technical assumptions it uses. The binding master-table tags of the collinear and TMD process theorems are [A]. Therefore (details and justification per entry in `ASSUMPTIONS.md` §00.3):
- a technical assumption that encodes a step of an **accepted all-order argument** of the literature (CSS, Bodwin, Collins 2011, Sterman) which has not been written in the precise form required here is tagged `\tagA`, and its 「地位」 field says "open in the precise form stated; covered at the level of the standard all-order argument by …" — this applies to all `asm:appM-*`, all `asm:appN-*` except `asm:appN-values` (convention, no tag), `asm:appN-ir-regulator` (`\tagC`) and `asm:appN-brst-nonlocal` (`\tagC`, named gap, merge decision MD1), and all `asm:appO-*` except `asm:appO-adjacent-swap` and `asm:appO-real-jets` (`\tagP`: proven in the scalar spectator model, argued for QCD jets; they enter only the QCD transfer of the App O model theorems, which are [P], and are premises of no [A] statement; v2.3);
- an assumption that is **not** covered by any accepted argument is tagged `\tagC` (or `\tagP` if partly proven) and is never a premise of an [A] statement: `asm:intro-*` (global non-perturbative, excluded from propagation for ordinary statements), `asm:appN-ir-regulator`, the hadronic LaMET hypotheses, the non-perturbative analyticity hypotheses of the Liu programme;
- the register of REFDOC §5.3 is refined accordingly: `(Z2)` is split off as `asm:appN-ir-regulator`; the non-local BRST classification assumed by Collins 2011 §11.3.2 becomes the explicit entry `asm:appN-brst-nonlocal` — `\tagC` at the merge (MD1: no all-order argument; frontier/others §8.3 assesses the general multilocal case as [C]); a premise only of `thm:appN-structure` and a named gap of the chapter [A] statements.

Correct (eikonal factor $n_A^\mu/(n_A\cdot k)$ for a soft gluon on an $A$-collinear line): soft attachments to $J_A$ ($J_B$) give past-pointing lines along $n_A$ ($n_B$) **in the soft factor**, and $A$-collinear longitudinal gluons attached to $H$ or $J_B$ give the past-pointing line along $n_B$ **in the collinear factor of $A$** (c_glauber §1.5 Steps 1–2). The statements below use the correct form.

## Appendix M — OPE：微扰证明、无质量 QCD、非微扰条件定理 / The OPE: perturbative proof, massless QCD, non-perturbative conditional theorems

`\label{app:appM}` · `appM_ope.tex` · **24 pp** · appendix (proofs)

**Purpose.** Split "the OPE has been proven" into checkable statements and prove what can be proven: (I) the perturbative-algebraic OPE in massive Euclidean models (BPHZ, normal products, one chain-expansion identity generating both the Zimmermann identities and the OPE identity) — unconditional; (II) the perturbative-analytic part (remainder, uniqueness, scaling of reduced coefficients, coordinate-space remainder) — conditional on one precisely stated remainder estimate (`asm:appM-remainder`), reduced to a zero-momentum matching estimate whose designated literature sources were not read (`rem:appM-remainder-reduction`; open problem); (III) massless QCD — the Euclidean OPE in DR+$\overline{\rm MS}$ as cited theorems ([A]), uniqueness blockwise under the condition (NE), the BRST reduction of the coefficients under one cited input ((Eε) of `asm:appM-brst-ope`), twist and chirality; (IV) forward on-shell kinematics: the per-graph expansion theorem `thm:appM-forward-expansion` ([R, R_PT]) and the fixed-order all-spin sum for partons (`cor:appM-forward-ope`, [A]); (V) the non-perturbative layer: from Wightman-type axioms a $Q$-uniform finite-subtraction dispersion relation, from the local OPE on a shrinking Euclidean segment plus positivity the fixed-$n$ Taylor coefficients, hence the non-perturbative moment theorem (all even $n\ge n_0$; $n<n_0$ iff the growth condition). App M delivers the proofs announced in Ch7 `dis`.

**Depends on.** Ch2 `qcd`: `def:prelim-qcd`, `def:prelim-brst`, `lem:prelim-brst-nilpotent`, `thm:prelim-slavnov-taylor`, `thm:prelim-composite-renorm`, `def:prelim-msbar`, `prop:prelim-rg`. Ch6 `ee`: `thm:ee-euclid-ir` (IR power counting at non-exceptional Euclidean momenta), `thm:ee-ope`, `conj:ee-np-ope`. Ch7 `dis`: `def:dis-kinematics`, `def:dis-compton`, `def:dis-twist`, `prop:dis-compton-analytic`, `prop:dis-dispersion`, `lem:dis-euclid-segment`, `lem:dis-tree-ope`, `prop:dis-wilson-partons` and the statements proved here. Ch8 `pdf`: `def:pdf-lightray`, `thm:pdf-moments-local`. App J: `prop:appJ-local-operators`, `rem:appJ-nonlocal`. App K: `lem:appK-hausdorff`, `thm:appK-even-moments`, `lem:appK-entire`, `lem:appK-markov`, `rem:appK-counterexamples`. App A: `sec:appA-plus` (weak convergence). - Reading guide: which Ch7 statement is proved where (the proof-delivery table as a printed table `tab:appM-delivery` is optional; the box suffices).
- The precise meaning of "the OPE holds" used in Ch7 (formulate once here, referenced by §M.4 and §M.8): **(OPE1)** Euclidean, direction-uniform asymptotic expansion with remainder $O(|q|^{1-N}\ln^k|q|)$ for $T^{\mu\nu}$; **(OPE2)** only gauge-invariant operators in physical matrix elements, twist 2 = $O_q^{(n)},O_g^{(n)}$; **(OPE3)** fixed-$n$ Taylor coefficients $t_n=4\sum_iC^{(n)}_{2,i}A^{(n)}_i+O(Q^{-2}\ln^kQ)$; **(OPE4)** RG; **(OPE5)** $t_n=4\int_{[0,1]}x^{n-2}F_2\,dx$ for even $n\ge n_0$, $F_2dx\ge0$. One moment needs one Taylor coefficient, not the all-spin sum; for hadrons (OPE1) informs only on $|\omega|\le\sqrt3M/Q$ (`lem:dis-euclid-segment`). Partonic structure functions are not positive measures, so the positivity route of §M.8 is non-perturbative only; its perturbative analogue is `prop:dis-ope-forward`.

### M.2 `sec:appM-bphz` BPHZ 与正规乘积 (2.5 pp)

Model of §M.2–§M.4: four-dimensional Euclidean theories of massive scalars (dimension 1) and Dirac fermions (dimension 3/2) with dimension-4 monomial interactions; composite vertices of dimension $d_O$ with $\delta_v$ derivatives; everything IR finite. Massless and gauge fields: §M.5–§M.6.

- **定义 `def:appM-bphz` — 图、表观发散度、森林与 $R$ 运算** (no tag). Graph $\Gamma$ (vertices $V$, internal lines $L$, external legs with incoming $p_j$); subgraph $\gamma$ = set of lines with their endpoints; $E(\gamma)$ = lines of $\Gamma$ attached to vertices of $\gamma$ but not in $\gamma$ (counted twice if both ends lie on $\gamma$) plus external legs at vertices of $\gamma$; renormalization part = 1PI subgraph; non-overlapping = disjoint or nested; $\Gamma/\gamma$ = contraction of each component of $\gamma$ to a point. Propagator $\Delta_\ell(k)=P_\ell(k)/(k^2+m_\ell^2)$, $\deg P_\ell=2d_\ell-2$. Superficial degree $\omega(\gamma)=4L(\gamma)+\sum_{\ell\in\gamma}(2d_\ell-4)+\sum_{v\in V(\gamma)}\delta_v$ (additive extension to disconnected $\gamma$: sum over components). Taylor operator $t^\delta_\gamma I_\gamma(k_\gamma,p_\gamma)=\sum_{|\alpha|\le\delta}\frac{p_\gamma^\alpha}{\alpha!}\partial^\alpha_{p_\gamma}I_\gamma(k_\gamma,0)$, $t^\delta\equiv0$ for $\delta<0$; Zimmermann's canonical (Kirchhoff) routing of external momenta; forest formula $R_\Gamma=\sum_F\prod^{\curvearrowleft}_{\gamma\in F}(-t^{\delta(\gamma)}_\gamma)I_\Gamma$ (smaller subgraphs act first) with subtraction degrees $\delta(\gamma)\ge\omega(\gamma)$; Bogoliubov recursion $R_\Gamma=(1-t_\Gamma)\bar R_\Gamma$. `% uses: none`.
- **引理 `lem:appM-degree` — 表观发散度的外线公式** (数学). $\omega(\gamma)=4-\sum_{e\in E(\gamma)}d_e+\sum_{v\in V(\gamma)}(d_v-4)$; with one composite vertex $\omega=d_O-\sum_{E}d_e$, with two composite vertices $A,B$: $\omega=d_A+d_B-4-\sum_Ed_e$. `\uses{def:appM-bphz}`. Proof: full ($L=I-V+1$, $\sum_v(d_v-4)=2\sum_\ell d_\ell+\sum_Ed_e+\sum_v\delta_v-4V$).
- **定理 `thm:appM-zimmermann` — Zimmermann 收敛定理（顶点可加的超减除）** [R, R_PT]. （$R_{\rm PT}$ …）（本定理只涉及部分子态。）Positive masses, real Euclidean external momenta, general line factors $P_\ell(k)/(k^2+m_\ell^2)^{n_\ell}$ and polynomial vertices ($\omega$ by actual degrees). If the subtraction degrees are **vertex-additive**, $\delta(\gamma)=\omega(\gamma)+\sum_{v\in V(\gamma)}c_v$ with $c_v\in\mathbb Z_{\ge0}$ fixed per vertex, then $\int\prod d^4k\,R_\Gamma$ converges absolutely, is smooth in the external momenta, and the subtractions are equivalent to local counterterm insertions. $c_v\equiv0$ is standard BPHZ. `\uses{def:appM-bphz}`. Proof: cited — `Zimmermann1969` (convergence of the forest formula in momentum space; canonical momenta), `Zimmermann1970` (oversubtractions, normal products), `Hepp1966`, `BogoliubovParasiuk1957` (locations: 「位置待核实」 for theorem numbers). Error type: exact (absolute convergence).
- **例 `ex:appM-nonadditive` — 非顶点可加的超减除会失败**. $\varphi^4$, two-loop four-point $\Gamma$ with a one-loop bubble $\gamma$ at a vertex, $\omega(\gamma)=\omega(\Gamma)=0$; choose $\delta(\gamma)=2$, $\delta(\Gamma)=0$ (so $\delta\ge\omega$ but not vertex-additive): $-t^2_\gamma$ produces $c_2P_\gamma^2$, which inserted into $\Gamma/\gamma$ has degree 2, not cured by $t^0_\Gamma$; both two-loop topologies (s-channel chain: logarithmic; "eye": quadratic divergence). Moral: the condition of `thm:appM-zimmermann` cannot be weakened to $\delta\ge\omega$. `\uses{thm:appM-zimmermann, lem:appM-degree}`. (Re-derived; reader check R5.)
- **定理 `thm:appM-weinberg` — Weinberg 定理（Hahn–Zimmermann 形式）** (数学，经典，引用). For $f(P,K)=\prod_jF_j(\ell_j(P,K))$, $F_j=P_j(\ell)/(\ell^2+m_j^2)^{n_j}$, $m_j>0$, with $\alpha_{S'}(F_j)=r_j-2n_j$ if $\ell_j|_{S'}\not\equiv0$ else 0, $D_{S'}(f)=\dim(S'\cap\ker\pi)+\sum_j\alpha_{S'}(F_j)$: (a) if $D_S<0$ for all non-zero $S\subset\ker\pi$, $I(P)=\int dK\,f$ converges absolutely; (b) with $\alpha(L)=\max\{D_{S'}:\pi(S')=L\}$, $|I(\eta\hat\ell+c)|\le K\eta^{\alpha(L)}(\ln\eta)^\beta$ for $\eta\ge2$, uniformly for $\hat\ell$ in compacta of the unit sphere of $L$ and $c$ in compacta. `% uses: none`. Proof: cited (`Weinberg1960`, `Hahn:1968HZ`).
- **推论 `cor:appM-weinberg-degree` — 渐近指数与子图发散度** (数学). $\alpha(L)\le\max\{\omega(\gamma):\gamma\text{ carries }L\}$, where $\gamma$ may be disconnected and $\omega$ is the additive extension (corrects the gap ERR-m24/R5 E7). `\uses{thm:appM-weinberg, def:appM-bphz}`. Proof: full ($S'_\gamma=\{P\in L,\ \ell_j=0\ \forall j\notin\gamma\}$, $\dim(S'_\gamma\cap\ker\pi)=4L(\gamma)$).
- **注 `rem:appM-forest-asymptotics` — 森林公式不能逐项用 Weinberg 定理** (no tag). Single forest terms are not integrable and grow faster than the sum; they recombine sector by sector (Zimmermann's sector method). Asymptotic expansions of zero-momentum BPHZ integrals: `Bergere:1977wz`; large-momentum and small-mass expansions `Smirnov:1990rz`, `Smirnov2002`; flow-equation bounds `Hollands:2011gf`. The frozen-$q$ form needed in §M.4 is not covered verbatim (hence `asm:appM-remainder`; its reduction: `rem:appM-remainder-reduction`).
- Figure: `fig:appM-forest` (FIGURES_INDEX_v2 N18; owner App M).

### M.3 `sec:appM-chain` 链展开与 OPE 恒等式 (4 pp)

- **定义 `def:appM-normal-product` — 正规乘积与冻结 $q$ 的双局域正规乘积** (no tag). (i) For a monomial $O$ ($d_O$) and $a\ge d_O$, $a-d_O\in\mathbb Z$: $N_a[O]$ is the forest formula with $\delta_a(\gamma)=a-\sum_{E(\gamma)}d_e$ for $\gamma\ni V_O$ and $\delta=\omega$ otherwise ($\delta_a-\omega=a-d_O$, i.e. $c_{V_O}=a-d_O$ in `thm:appM-zimmermann`); $N[O]\equiv N_{d_O}[O]$. (ii) For monomials $A,B$, $D\equiv d_A+d_B-4$; auxiliary line $\ell_x$ ($V_A$–$V_B$, "propagator" $e^{-iq\cdot x}$), $\Gamma^\circ=\Gamma\cup\{\ell_x\}$; $\gamma$ is an **AB part** iff $V_A,V_B\in\gamma$ and $\gamma\cup\{\ell_x\}$ is 1PI in $\Gamma^\circ$; $\omega(\gamma)=D-\sum_{E(\gamma)}d_e$. (iii) Two subtractions, $a\in D+\mathbb Z_{\ge0}$: the **T-product** $\tilde G^T_{AB}(q;p)$ = BPHZ with $q$ external (1PI AB parts $t^{\omega}_{(p,q)}$, non-1PI AB parts unsubtracted); the **frozen-$q$ bilocal normal product** $\tilde N_a(q;p)$ of $N_a[A(x)B(0)]$: every AB part (including non-1PI) with $t^{(a)}_\gamma\equiv t^{\delta_a(\gamma)}_p$, $\delta_a=a-\sum_Ed_e$ (Taylor in $p$ only, $q$ frozen), other renormalization parts with $t^\omega$. `\uses{def:appM-bphz}`.
- **引理 `lem:appM-contraction` — 收缩与桥** (数学). For $\gamma^*\subset\sigma$, $\gamma^*$ connected: $\sigma$ connected ⇔ $\sigma/\gamma^*$ connected; a line of $\sigma\setminus\gamma^*$ is a bridge of $\sigma$ ⇔ it is a bridge of $\sigma/\gamma^*$; a bridge of $\sigma$ lying in $\gamma^*$ is a bridge of $\gamma^*$. Hence for 1PI $\gamma^*$: $\sigma$ 1PI ⇔ $\sigma/\gamma^*$ 1PI. `\uses{def:appM-bphz}`. Proof: full.
- **引理 `lem:appM-chain-expansion` — 链展开恒等式** (数学). Marked vertices $M\ne\emptyset$; family $\mathcal S$ of connected subgraphs containing $M$; *admissible* = in $\mathcal S$, or a renormalization part not containing all of $M$; forests = sets of pairwise non-overlapping admissible subgraphs. (i) The $\mathcal S$-elements of a forest form a chain. (ii) For operators $\tau_\gamma,\tau'_\gamma$ on $\mathcal S$ and $t^{\delta(\gamma)}$ elsewhere,
  $R^\tau_\Gamma=R^{\tau'}_\Gamma+\sum_{\gamma^*\in\mathcal S}\sum_{F\ni\gamma^*}\Big[\prod^{\curvearrowleft}_{\gamma\in F,\gamma\not\subseteq\gamma^*}(-\tau_\gamma)\Big](\tau'_{\gamma^*}-\tau_{\gamma^*})\Big[\prod^{\curvearrowleft}_{\gamma\in F,\gamma\subsetneq\gamma^*}(-\tau'_\gamma)\Big]I_\Gamma .$
  (iii) Under the contraction condition **(Ctr)** — for $\sigma\supsetneq\gamma^*$: $\sigma$ admissible ⇔ $\sigma/\gamma^*$ is a renormalization part of $\Gamma/\gamma^*$ containing the image vertex $v_*$ — each forest $F\ni\gamma^*$ splits uniquely as $F_{\rm in}\sqcup\{\gamma^*\}\sqcup F_{\rm out}$ with $F_{\rm out}$ in bijection with the forests of $\Gamma/\gamma^*$, and the $\gamma^*$-term of (ii) is the forest sum of $\Gamma/\gamma^*$ (with $\tau$ on subgraphs containing $v_*$) with vertex factor $v_{\gamma^*}=(\tau'_{\gamma^*}-\tau_{\gamma^*})\bar R^{\tau'}_{\gamma^*}$, $\bar R^{\tau'}_{\gamma^*}=\sum_{F_{\rm in}}\prod_{\gamma\in F_{\rm in}}(-\tau'_\gamma)I_{\gamma^*}$. For $M=\{V_O\}$, (Ctr) follows from `lem:appM-contraction`. `\uses{def:appM-bphz, lem:appM-contraction}`. Proof: full (write $-\tau=-\tau'+(\tau'-\tau)$ along the chain and group by the innermost difference; routing compatibility under contraction, `Zimmermann1969`). Renamed hypothesis: the reference's "(H)" is (Ctr) here (no clash with (H1)–(H5) of `thm:method-template`).
- **定理 `thm:appM-zimmermann-identity` — Zimmermann 恒等式** [R, R_PT]. （$R_{\rm PT}$ …）（本定理只涉及部分子态。）For $d_O\le a<a'$ in $d_O+\mathbb Z$: $N_a[O]=N_{a'}[O]+\sum_{O':\,a<d_{O'}\le a'}u_{O'}N_{a'}[O']$, $O'$ local monomials, $u_{O'}=m^{d_O-d_{O'}}\hat u_{O'}$ finite (zero-momentum Taylor coefficients of 1PI vertex functions of $N_a[O]$). `\uses{def:appM-normal-product, lem:appM-chain-expansion, thm:appM-zimmermann}`. Proof: full — `lem:appM-chain-expansion` with $\tau=t^{\delta_{a'}}$, $\tau'=t^{\delta_a}$; $v_{\gamma^*}=-\sum_{\delta_a<|\alpha|\le\delta_{a'}}\frac{p^\alpha}{\alpha!}\partial^\alpha_p\bar R^{(a)}_{\gamma^*}|_{p=0}$ converges (no overall subtraction since $\delta_a(\gamma^*)-|\alpha|<0$; vertex-additivity survives differentiation, $\partial_pt^\delta=t^{\delta-1}\partial_p$); $p^\alpha$ times the legs $E(\gamma^*)$ is the vertex of $O'$ with $d_{O'}=\sum_Ed_e+|\alpha|\in(a,a']$. Literature: `Zimmermann1970`, `Zimmermann:1972te`.
- **推论 `cor:appM-reduction` — 化到最小正规乘积** [R, R_PT]. （$R_{\rm PT}$ …）$N_a[O]=\sum_{d_O\le d_{O'}\le a}z_{OO'}N[O']$, $z_{OO}=1$. `\uses{thm:appM-zimmermann-identity}`. Proof: full (induction on $a-d_O$).
- **例 `ex:appM-callan-symanzik` — $\varphi^4$ 中的 Zimmermann 恒等式**. $O=\varphi^2$, $a=2\to a'=4$: $m^2N_2[\varphi^2]=m^2N_4[\varphi^2]+\hat u_{\varphi^4}N_4[\varphi^4]+\hat u_{\varphi\partial^2\varphi}N_4[\varphi\partial^2\varphi]+\hat u_{(\partial\varphi)^2}N_4[\partial_\mu\varphi\partial^\mu\varphi]$ ($\varphi^3$ excluded by $\mathbb Z_2$, $\varphi\partial\varphi$ by Lorentz invariance); the coefficient of $N_{a'}[O]$ is exactly 1 because $|\alpha|>\delta_a(\gamma^*)=a-d_O\ge0$. The identity behind the Callan–Symanzik equation (`Callan:1970yg`, `Symanzik:1970rt`). `\uses{thm:appM-zimmermann-identity}`.
- **引理 `lem:appM-routing` — 冻结 $q$ 时外动量分配的相容性** (数学). (New auxiliary lemma; repairs ERR-m24/R5 E8.) In $\Gamma^\circ$, treat $q$ as an external momentum injected at $V_A$ and extracted at $V_B$ that is never Taylor-expanded. The canonical (minimal-norm Kirchhoff) routing of $\Gamma^\circ$ with respect to all external momenta $(p_j,q)$ is linear in $(p,q)$; for every AB part or renormalization part $\gamma$, the restriction of the canonical flow of $\Gamma^\circ$ to $\gamma$ differs from the canonical flow of $\gamma$ (with its induced external momenta) by a loop flow of $\gamma$; hence the operators $t^{(a)}_\gamma=t^{\delta_a(\gamma)}_p$ act on the $p$-components only, commute with the contraction of AB subparts, and (Ctr) holds for $M=\{V_A,V_B\}$, $\mathcal S$ = AB parts; after contracting an AB part $\gamma^*$, $q$ no longer flows in $\Gamma/\gamma^*$ ($\ell_x$ becomes a self-loop). `\uses{def:appM-normal-product, lem:appM-contraction}`. Proof: full (adapt Zimmermann's canonical-momenta lemma, `Zimmermann1969` §2–3 (位置待核实), with $q$ in the list of external momenta; the restriction property holds for any external vector because the minimal-norm flow is an orthogonal projection).
- **引理 `lem:appM-integrability` — 冻结 $q$ 正规乘积的良定义与链分解** [R, R_PT]. （$R_{\rm PT}$ …）With $\tau=t^{(a)}$ on AB parts, $\tau'=t^\omega_{(p,q)}$ on 1PI AB parts and $\tau'=0$ on non-1PI AB parts, $\vartheta$ = indicator of 1PI: (i) $R^T_\Gamma=R^{(a)}_\Gamma+\sum_{\gamma^*\in\mathcal S}(\text{forest sum of }\Gamma/\gamma^*\text{ with }t^{(a)}\text{ on subgraphs}\ni v_*)[v_{\gamma^*}]$, $v_{\gamma^*}=(t^{(a)}_{\gamma^*}-\tau'_{\gamma^*})\bar R^T_{\gamma^*}$; (ii) $v_{\gamma^*}=\sum_{|\alpha|\le\delta_a(\gamma^*)}\frac{p_{\gamma^*}^\alpha}{\alpha!}\hat c^{\gamma^*}_\alpha(k_{\gamma^*};q)$ with $\hat c^{\gamma^*}_\alpha=\big(1-\vartheta(\gamma^*)t_q^{\omega(\gamma^*)-|\alpha|}\big)\partial^\alpha_p\bar R^T_{\gamma^*}(k;q,p)|_{p=0}$ absolutely integrable and $c^{\gamma^*}_\alpha(q)=\int\hat c^{\gamma^*}_\alpha$ smooth (1PI $\gamma^*$: full BPHZ integrand with external momentum $q$ only, degree $\omega-|\alpha|$; non-1PI: product of fully subtracted 1PI blobs and bridge propagators); (iii) every term of (i) is absolutely integrable (factorization $\sum_\alpha\hat c_\alpha(k_{\gamma^*};q)\,g_\alpha(k';p)$ with $g_\alpha$ an oversubtracted BPHZ integrand of $\Gamma/\gamma^*$, $c_{v_*}=a-\sum_{E(\gamma^*)}d_e-|\alpha|$; Tonelli); hence $R^{(a)}_\Gamma$ is integrable and $\tilde N_a$ smooth. `\uses{def:appM-normal-product, lem:appM-chain-expansion, lem:appM-routing, thm:appM-zimmermann}`. Proof: full.
- **引理 `lem:appM-contact` — 接触项** [R, R_PT]. （$R_{\rm PT}$ …）Replacing all AB-part subtractions in the T-product by $t^{\omega+c}_{(p,q)}$ ($c\ge0$) changes $\tilde G^T_{AB}$ only by (polynomials in $q$) × (Green functions of local insertions); hence $G_{AB}(x;p)$ at $x\neq0$ is independent of the choice and equals the Green function of $T\,A(x)B(0)$. `\uses{def:appM-normal-product, thm:appM-zimmermann}`. Proof: full.
- **定理 `thm:appM-ope-identity` — 微扰论中的 OPE 恒等式（有质量模型）** [R, R_PT]. （$R_{\rm PT}$ …）（本定理只涉及部分子态。）At each order and for $a\in D+\mathbb Z_{\ge0}$, exactly
  $\tilde G^T_{AB}(q;p)=\sum_{d_O\le a}\tilde C_O(q)\,\tilde G_{N[O]}(p)+\tilde N_a(q;p)$,
  with coefficients $\tilde C_O$ smooth in $q$, independent of $p$ and of the external fields, given by absolutely convergent "hard" integrals; $\tilde C_O=\sum_{d_{O'}\le d_O}\tilde C^{(a)}_{O'}z_{O'O}$ (reduction of the unreduced coefficients $\tilde C^{(a)}_O=\sum_{\gamma^*}c^{\gamma^*}_\alpha$); all $d_O\in D+\mathbb Z$. `\uses{lem:appM-integrability, lem:appM-contact, cor:appM-reduction, lem:appM-routing}`. Proof: full — integrate (i) of `lem:appM-integrability`, expand by (ii); $p^\alpha E(\gamma^*)$ is the vertex of $O_{E,\alpha}$ with $d\le a$, and the subtraction degrees in $\Gamma/\gamma^*$ are those of $N_a[O_{E,\alpha}]$; reduce by `cor:appM-reduction`. Literature: the coordinate-space short-distance expansion `Zimmermann1973`, `Wilson1969`, `Wilson:1972ee`; momentum space `Anikin:1978tj`. Error type: exact identity.
- **例 `ex:appM-tree` — 树图 OPE 就是 Taylor 展开**. $A=B=\varphi^2/2$ ($D=0$), single line $V_A$–$V_B$ (non-1PI AB part, $\omega=-2$, $\delta_a=a-2$): $\tilde N_a=\Delta(q+p_1)-\sum_{|\alpha|\le a-2}\frac{p_1^\alpha}{\alpha!}\partial^\alpha\Delta(q)=O(|p_1|^{a-1}|q|^{-a-1})$, matching $D-1-a$; in $x$ space the remainder is $\Delta(x)[e^{ip_1\cdot x}-\sum_{j\le a-2}(ip_1\cdot x)^j/j!]$ — the Taylor expansion of $\varphi(x)$ with operators $\varphi\partial^\alpha\varphi$ (Fourier identities $\int e^{-iqx}\Delta(q+p)=e^{ipx}\Delta(x)$, $\int e^{-iqx}\partial^\alpha\Delta=(ix)^\alpha\Delta(x)$). `\uses{thm:appM-ope-identity}`.
- **注 `rem:appM-mechanism` — 指数 $D-1-a$ 的启发式来源** (no tag). In a sector where the lines of $\gamma_h$ carry momenta $\sim\eta$, the component $\gamma_0\ni V_A$ contains $V_B$ and has no bridge in $\gamma_0\cup\ell_x$, hence is an AB part (rigorous graph theory); its Taylor remainder scales as $\eta^{\omega(\gamma_0)-\delta_a(\gamma_0)-1}=\eta^{D-1-a}$ independently of $\gamma_0$; frozen $q$ does not worsen high-energy behaviour. Not a proof (straddling subgraphs, nested scales) — hence `asm:appM-remainder`.
- Figure: `fig:appM-handbag-ab` (FIGURES_INDEX_v2 S13; owner App M): handbag as an AB part (hard, $C^{(n)}$) vs as a reduced graph (collinear, $A^{(n)}$); the overlap is separated by the oversubtraction (massive case); in massless QCD IR counterterms are needed (§M.5).

### M.4 `sec:appM-remainder` 余项、唯一性与标度 (3.5 pp)

- **假设 `asm:appM-remainder` — 冻结 $q$ 双局域正规乘积的动量空间余项估计** [\tagA]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. Content: let $\mathcal H_{a,\Gamma}$ be the span of the functions obtained from $\tilde N_{a,\Gamma}$ by finitely many $\partial/\partial p_j^\nu$, multiplications by $p_{j\mu}$ and $m\partial_m$; there is an integer $k$ such that every $h\in\mathcal H_{a,\Gamma}$ obeys $|h(q;p)|\le K_h|q|^{D-1-a}(\ln|q|)^k$ for $|q|\ge2$, uniformly in $q/|q|$ and for $p$ in compact sets (massive Euclidean model, each order). `\uses{def:appM-normal-product}`.
- **引理 `lem:appM-derivative-bounds` — 由齐次性、O(4) 与 Lagrange 恒等式得到的导数界** (数学). If every $h\in\mathcal H$ obeys $|h|\le K_h|q|^\varrho\ln^k|q|$, then $|\partial^\beta_qh|\le K'_\beta|q|^{\varrho-|\beta|}\ln^k|q|$. `\uses{def:appM-normal-product}`. Proof: full — (1) homogeneity of integrands and of zero-momentum Taylor operators under $(q,p,m,k)\to\lambda(\cdot)$ and the Euler relation $q\cdot\partial_qh=D_hh-\sum p\partial_ph-\sum m\partial_mh\in\mathcal H$; (2) $O(4)$ covariance $L^{(q)}_{\mu\nu}h=-\sum_jL^{(p_j)}_{\mu\nu}h+\Sigma_{\mu\nu}h\in\mathcal H$; (3) Lagrange identity $|q|^2|v|^2=|q\cdot v|^2+\sum_{\mu<\nu}|q_\mu v_\nu-q_\nu v_\mu|^2$ (real $q$, complex $v$) ⇒ $|q||\partial_qh|\le|q\cdot\partial h|+\sum|L^{(q)}h|$; (4) induction on $|\beta|$.
- **定义 `def:appM-blocks` — 精确投影、块与条件 (NE)** (no tag). Massless setting of §M.5 (DR + $\overline{\rm MS}$, covariant gauge, D-dimensional operator basis: formal tensors with $g^\mu{}_\mu=D$ and $\gamma^{[\mu_1\cdots\mu_r]}$ of every rank). Let $\sum_{d_O\le a}\Delta C_O(q)\tilde G_{[O];\Phi}(p)=O(|q|^{1-a}\ln^k|q|)$ uniformly in $\hat q\in S^3$, each $\Delta C_O$ being $|q|^{2-d_O}$ times a polynomial in $L=\ln(q^2/\mu^2)$. The **exact projections** act on the coefficient side only: (Pr1) $(\mu\nu)$-(anti)symmetrization; (Pr2) the trace/traceless split in $\mu\nu$; (Pr3) projection onto spherical harmonics of degree $\ell$ in $\hat q$ (legitimate because the remainder bound is uniform in $\hat q$); (Pr4) separation of the terms $|q|^{2-d}L^m$, $d\le a$ — afterwards the relation holds **exactly**; (Pr5) at $D=4$, projection of the output tensor onto an O(4)-isotypic type $\rho$ (Schur's lemma: $\Pi_\rho t_O=t_O\Pi^{W_O}_\rho$ for the equivariant contraction $t_O:W_O\to{\rm Out}$ of the $O$-term). A **block** is the set $\mathcal S$ of operators of one dimension $d$ that survive (Pr1)–(Pr5); on a block the relation reads $\sum_{O\in\mathcal S}\Pi_\rho t_O(\tilde G_{[O]})=0$. $\mathcal S$ satisfies **(NE)** if at $D=4$ the map $(t_O)_{O\in\mathcal S}\mapsto\sum_Ot_O(V^{(4)}_O)$ is injective ($V^{(4)}_O$: four-dimensional tree vertices). The **twist-2 blocks** $\mathcal B^\pm_n$ ($n\ge2$) have $d=n+2$ and $\rho=(\frac n2,\frac n2)^\pm$ (rank-$n$ symmetric traceless tensors of either parity; O(4) labels $[n]$ and $[n,1,1]$). The names (Pr1)–(Pr5), (NE) are local to App M. `\uses{def:prelim-qcd, def:dis-twist}`.
- **引理 `lem:appM-ne` — 条件 (NE) 的适用范围** (数学). In the setting of `def:appM-blocks`: (i) in the $(\mu\nu)$-symmetric channel with $d_O\le5$, (NE) holds; (ii) for every twist-2 block $\mathcal B^\pm_n$, $n\ge2$, (NE) holds, and no four-quark operator lies in $\mathcal B^\pm_n$; (iii) (NE) fails in the $(\mu\nu)$-antisymmetric channel at $d_O=5$ (already at tree level: the rank-5 structure $2\gamma^{[\nu l\alpha q\mu]}/q^4$) and in four-quark blocks with $d_O\ge6$ ($\Gamma^{(5)}\cdot\Gamma_{(5)}=+D(D-1)(D-2)(D-3)(D-4)$); there uniqueness at $D=4$ needs an evanescent-operator prescription (`Dugan:1990de`, `Herrlich:1994kh`). `\uses{def:appM-blocks}`. Proof: full — by the second fundamental theorem for O(4) and the basis $\{\gamma^{[r]}\}_{r\le4}$ of Cl(4), an identity valid at $D=4$ but not at formal $D$ is spanned by terms containing an antisymmetrizer over $\ge5$ slots (a Dirac structure of rank $\ge5$ or a Gram/Schouten $\delta^{[a_1..a_5]}_{[b_1..b_5]}$), each slot needing a distinct carrier (a free index, a momentum or a polarization). (i) An antisymmetrized set contains at most one of $\mu,\nu$ and at most one $\hat q$, and at most $d_O-3\le2$ derivative or gauge slots of $O$; so every set has $\le4$ carriers. (ii) *Content:* $O\in\mathcal B^\pm_n$ requires $W_O\supset\rho$, so the maximal number $y(O)$ of mutually symmetrizable free slots is $\ge n$ (Littlewood restriction keeps the first row). *Count:* derivatives and gauge fields give $\le1$ slot each at cost 1, a quark bilinear $\le1$ slot of a symmetric set at cost 3, ghosts and $B$ none; with $b$ bilinears and slot-free cost $\kappa$, $n\le y\le(n+2-3b-\kappa)+b$, so $2b+\kappa\le2$, $b\le1$ (no four-quark operator); for $b=1$, $\kappa=0$ and the Dirac structure has rank $r'\in\{1,3\}$, because its remaining indices can only be filled by $\mu,\nu$ and Dirac structures of rank $\ge5$ with free indices vanish at $D=4$ ($\Lambda^{r'}\mathbb R^4=0$ for $r'\ge5$). *(NE):* the $\rho$-projection replaces the first-row output by a null vector $z$ of degree $n$ (plus two antisymmetrized auxiliary vectors for $[n,1,1]$); a Gram identity needs $\ge n+6$ momentum/polarization carriers and a Dirac-mixed identity $\ge n+3$, against a supply of $\le n+4$ ($b=0$) or $\le n+1$ ($b=1$). (iii) The explicit structures. Checks: `verify/extend/X3-ope/scripts` f6 (tree-level rank-5 structure), f7 ($+D!/(D-5)!$; even/odd-dimensional Clifford facts; the slot count for $n\le12$). A new argument for an expected fact (no novelty marker).
- **引理 `lem:appM-uniqueness` — OPE 系数的唯一性** [R, R_PT]. （$R_{\rm PT}$ …）(a) *Order by order (massive):* if $[\sum_{d_O\le a}\Delta_O(q)\tilde G_{N[O]}(p)]^{(r)}=O(|q|^\varrho\ln^k|q|)$ for all external field types, $p$ in compact sets and all orders $r$, then each $\Delta^{(r)}_O=O(|q|^\varrho\ln^k|q|)$. (b) *Exact (massless), blockwise:* in every block of `def:appM-blocks` that satisfies (NE), two coefficient families giving a remainder $O(|q|^{D-1-a}\ln^k|q|)$ at Euclidean non-exceptional momenta, both $|q|^{D-d_O}$ times polynomials in $\ln(q^2/\mu^2)$ (with $\hat q$-dependent coefficients), have equal projected coefficients at each order; by `lem:appM-ne` this covers the symmetric channel at $d_O\le5$ and all twist-2 blocks, so all twist-2 invariant functions ($C^{(n)}_{L,i}$, $C^{(n)}_{2,i}$ and the axial analogues) are unique for every $n$; in blocks without (NE) (four-quark blocks with $d_O\ge6$; the antisymmetric channel at $d_O=5$) uniqueness at $D=4$ needs an evanescent prescription. (c) *Formal $D$:* at fixed generic $\varepsilon$, for bare functions with formal-$D$ tree vertices, (a) holds without (NE), coefficientwise in the Laurent expansion in $\varepsilon$, and graded-homogeneous coefficients of degree $>\varrho$ vanish. `\uses{def:appM-normal-product, def:appM-blocks, lem:appM-ne}`. Proof: full — (a), (c) induction in $g^2$: at tree level only operators whose fields match the external string contribute, through their vertex polynomials, which are independent as formal-$D$ tensors (at $D=4$ this is (NE)); lower orders are controlled by induction since the matrix elements do not depend on $q$; distinct powers $|q|^{\kappa-2j\varepsilon}$ separate the orders (known in spirit); (b) apply (Pr1)–(Pr5) to the difference of the two expansions, then (a) for each $L^m$ coefficient: $\Delta_O=e^{(D-d_O)L}P(L)$ with $|P(L)|\le Ke^{-(a+1-d_O)L}L^k\to0$ forces $P\equiv0$; for $O^{(n)}_{q,g}$, $W_O=[n]$ is $\rho$-isotypic, so every harmonic component ($\ell\in\{n-2,n,n+2\}$) of $\Delta C_O$ lies in $\mathcal B^+_n$.

- **例 `ex:appM-unreduced` — 未约化系数违反标度（锐化值）**. Massive $\varphi^4$, $A=B=\varphi^2/2$, $a=4$; $\gamma^*$ = line $\ell_1$ ($V_A$–$V_B$) plus path $V_A$–$X_1$–$X_2$–$V_B$ (each $X$ with two external legs), $\omega(\gamma^*)=-4$; proper AB subparts unsubtracted. - **引理 `lem:appM-symbol` — 动量空间余项到坐标空间余项** (数学). Let $f\in C^\infty(\mathbb R^4)$ with $|\partial^\beta f|\le K_\beta(1+|q|)^{\varrho-|\beta|}\ln^k(2+|q|)$ and $g=\hat f$. (1) *Circularity:* "a proven momentum-space OPE discharges `asm:appM-remainder` through `lem:appM-uniqueness`" is circular: `lem:appM-uniqueness`(a), applied to $\sum_O(\tilde C_O-C'_O)\tilde G_{N[O]}=\mathcal R'-\tilde N_a$, needs $\tilde N_a$ to be small, which is the assumption itself (slot X3a: not delivered). (2) *Reduction* (written out in the X3 report, Lemma A.7; complete given its premise): in the massive model of §M.2, `asm:appM-remainder` holds per order **iff** there are $p$-independent coefficients $C'_O$ such that every element of the span generated from $\mathcal R'=\tilde G^T-\sum_{d_O\le a}C'_O\tilde G_{N[O]}$ by $\partial_p$, multiplication by $p$ and $m\partial_m$ is bounded by $K|q|^{D-1-a}\ln^k|q|$, per order, uniformly in $\hat q$, for $p$ in compact sets **containing 0** (the estimate (CTp)). Steps: over-subtraction $\partial^\alpha_p\tilde N_{a,\Gamma}(q;0)=0$ for $|\alpha|\le a-\sum_{E(\Gamma)}d_e$ (the maximal AB part is compatible with all forests); the normalization matrix $M_{(E,\alpha),O}=\partial^\alpha_p\tilde G^E_{N[O]}(0)$ is block-injective at order 0; matching $\Delta C=M^{-1}_{\rm sq}(\partial\mathcal R'|_{p=0})$, likewise for $(m\partial_m)^j\Delta C$. This suffices for `thm:appM-scaling`(ii)–(iv) and `cor:appM-coordinate`. No novelty is claimed (zero-momentum normalization of Zimmermann normal products). (3) *Literature:* position-space remainder theorems, as described in the secondary literature (e.g. `Smirnov:1990rz` p. 110), do not supply (CTp); the designated sources `Zimmermann1973` (to be read first), `Anikin:1978tj`, `Zavyalov:1990kv` and `Bergere:1977wz` were not read in full, so `asm:appM-remainder` stays \tagA (open problem, Ch25). (4) The DR route of §M.5 (`prop:dis-ope-euclid`) does not use `asm:appM-remainder`.

### M.5 `sec:appM-massless` 无质量 QCD (1.5 pp)

- *Target:* **`prop:dis-ope-euclid`** (Ch7, [A]) — 欧氏非例外动量下 Green 函数的逐图渐近展开: massless QCD ($n_f$ massless quarks, covariant gauges with $\xi$ in a compact set $\Xi\ni1$, DR + $\overline{\rm MS}$, D-dimensional basis including gauge-variant, ghost and evanescent operators), at each order $r$, for Euclidean non-exceptional $(p,q)$ (no proper partial sum of external momenta vanishes), for $A=B=J$ ($D=2$): **(A1)** $\tilde G^T_{JJ;\Phi}-\sum_{d_O\le a}C_O(q;\mu,\xi)\tilde G_{[O];\Phi}=O(|q|^{1-a}\ln^k|q|)$ uniformly in $\hat q$, in compact non-exceptional $p$ and in $\xi$; **(A2)** $C_O=|q|^{2-d_O}\times$ a polynomial of degree $\le r$ in $L=\ln(q^2/\mu^2)$ with covariant coefficients polynomial in $\xi$; **(A3)** $C^{\overline{\rm MS}}=C^{\rm bare}Z^{-1}$ is finite ($C^{\rm bare}_O$: the sum over the hard subgraphs containing both currents of their DR Taylor coefficients, a function of $(q,g_0,\xi_0,\varepsilon)$ only); **(A4)** blockwise uniqueness under (NE) (`lem:appM-uniqueness`(b), `lem:appM-ne`): all twist-2 coefficients are unique for every $n$. *Proof location (sketch with citations):* (A1), (A3) graph by graph and in operator form at each $\xi$, cited: `Smirnov:1990rz` — checked in full text: its theorem (p. 117) is a mixed statement (a distribution in the coordinate variables and a function of non-exceptional Euclidean momenta, in analytic regularization), the DR function form is only asserted (p. 118), and ghosts, gauge-variant bases and composite spectators are not treated —, `Smirnov2002`, `Chetyrkin:1982zq`, `ChetyrkinTkachov1981` ($R^*$ for coefficient functions); infrared finiteness from `Breitenlohner:1976te` Thm 1 (checked: connected graphs whose internal vertices all have IR degree $\ge4$, with fields of IR dimension $\ge1$, have an $\varepsilon\to0$ limit as tempered distributions in all external momenta; covariant-gauge QCD qualifies); uniformity in $\xi$ by Lagrange interpolation (polynomial in $\xi$ at fixed order); for $\Phi\ne\varnothing$ no additive renormalization of $\tilde G^T$ is needed (the only degree-0 local terms $g^{\mu\nu}AA$, $g^{\mu\nu}\bar cc$ violate the contact-free electromagnetic Ward identity for neutral legs); (A2) from the homogeneity of degree $2-d_O-2k\varepsilon$ of the $k$-loop hard part in bare $(g_0,\xi_0)$; (A4) by `lem:appM-uniqueness`(b). BPHZL route (`Lowenstein:1974qt`, `LowensteinZimmermann1975`): convergence known, remainder estimate open; the two schemes differ by finite renormalizations **and** by finite non-invariant counterterms restoring the Slavnov–Taylor identities in BPHZL (`Breitenlohner:1975hg`, `Breitenlohner:1976te`; ERR-M28). The DR route needs no `asm:appM-remainder` (`rem:appM-remainder-reduction`(4)). Status [A] under decision D3, **unchanged after the verification** (S63-1: the cited theorem was checked and its scope falls short of (A1), (A3) as stated; slot X3b not passed); literature status `Collins1984` §12.8 ("proved in a gauge theory the same way"), `IzubuchiEtAl2018` Sec. II ("widely assumed"); pure Yang–Mills `Hollands:2007zg` (not verified), `Frob:2015uqy`, `Frob:2016mzv` (preprint).
- **注 `rem:appM-exceptional` — 例外动量与前向矩阵元** (no tag). The forward Compton configuration $(p,-p)$ is exceptional and on-shell partons are massless; in BPHZL the IR finiteness of zero-momentum gauge-invariant twist-2 insertions in off-shell forward kinematics can be checked at low orders but has no all-order proof; in DR these insertions exist at every order (`prop:appM-zero-momentum-insertion`, [A]), the algebraic identities hold for any momenta, and for forward on-shell partonic amplitudes the analytic step is the per-graph theorem `thm:appM-forward-expansion` (§M.7). Hence the rigorous perturbative OPE with a remainder bound is at Euclidean non-exceptional momenta; the forward on-shell remainder is `asm:appM-forward` (reduced in §M.7 by `cor:appM-forward-ope`, not discharged), and the hadronic transition is `asm:intro-np-ope`. `fig:appM-euclid-forward` (FIGURES_INDEX_v2 N19). Misconception guarded: 「前向在壳部分子矩阵元直接给出 Wilson 系数，无需额外步骤」 (WRITER_SPEC_v2 §6.9).
- **命题 `prop:appM-zero-momentum-insertion` — 零动量扭度 2 算符插入在维数正规化中的存在性** [A]. For $n\ge2$ the first-order insertion of $\int d^Dx\,O^{(n)}_i(x)$ (zero momentum transfer) into a two-point function of elementary fields exists in DR at every order; for $p^2<0$ it equals $(-p^2)^{a}\sum_kc_k\ln^k(-p^2/\mu^2)$, with $a$ fixed by dimensional analysis. `\uses{def:dis-twist}`. Proof plan: $\lambda\int O^{(n)}$ is an integrated term of IR degree $n+2\ge4$, and so are its $\overline{\rm MS}$ counterterms; all QCD vertices have IR degree 4 and the fields have IR dimension $\ge1$ in every covariant gauge, so `Breitenlohner:1976te` Thm 1 (hypotheses checked in the X3 report) gives a tempered distribution in $p$; on $p^2<0$ it is a function $f(p^2)$, and dimensional analysis with polynomial $\ln\mu$ dependence, $f(\lambda^2s)=\lambda^{2a}\sum_k(\ln\lambda)^kf_k(s)$, forces the stated form. It settles, for off-shell forward two-point functions, the question left open in `rem:appM-exceptional`. **地位与缺口.** [A]: the $\varepsilon$ of `Breitenlohner:1976te` is the damping regulator of that construction, not the dimension shift of DR, and the identification of its limit with the dimensionally regularized $\overline{\rm MS}$ insertion used here rests on the relation between that paper and `Breitenlohner:1975hg`, which the verification did not check; upgrade path to [R, R_PT]: that identification written out, plus a second independent confirmation.
- **假设 `asm:appM-forward` — 前向在壳无质量部分子矩阵元的 OPE 余项** [\tagA]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. Content: massless QCD, DR (Laurent coefficients in $\varepsilon$), on-shell parton target $j$ ($p^2=0$, physical polarizations, spin averaged), Euclidean direction $\hat q$ with $2p\cdot\hat q$ purely imaginary: at each order $T^{\mu\nu}_j-\sum_{d_O\le N}\tilde C^{\mu\nu}_O(q;\mu)\langle p|[O]_\mu|p\rangle=O(|q|^{1-N}\ln^k|q|)$, uniformly in the direction. `\uses{def:dis-compton}`.

### M.6 `sec:appM-brst` BRST、规范不变算符与扭度 (3.5 pp)

- Recap (no new environment): BRST in the binding conventions (`def:prelim-brst`; $sA^a_\mu=D^{ab}_\mu c^b$, $s\psi=igc^at^a\psi$, $sc^a=-\frac g2f^{abc}c^bc^c$, $s\bar c^a=B^a$, $sB^a=0$; $\mathcal L_{\rm gf}+\mathcal L_{\rm gh}=s(\bar c^a(\partial\cdot A^a+\frac\xi2B^a))$), nilpotency (`lem:prelim-brst-nilpotent`), Slavnov–Taylor identities (`thm:prelim-slavnov-taylor`), antifield master equation; no anomaly for vector-like QCD.
- **定义 `def:appM-alien` — 规范不变算符、BRST 恰当算符与运动方程算符** (no tag). Local operators of ghost number 0 and dimension $d$: (a) gauge invariant (colour-singlet polynomials in $\psi,\bar\psi,F_{\mu\nu}$ and covariant derivatives); (b) BRST exact $s\Lambda$; (c) equation-of-motion operators $X\cdot\delta S/\delta\phi$; (b)+(c) = **alien** operators $=\mathcal S_0(\phi^*X+\Lambda)|_{\phi^*=0}$. `\uses{def:prelim-brst}`.
- **定理 `thm:appM-local-cohomology` — 定域 BRST 上同调** (数学，经典，引用). For unintegrated local functions of ghost number 0: (a) $\mathcal S_0\Delta=0$ ⇒ $\Delta=\sum_jc_jO^{\rm GI}_j+\mathcal S_0\Xi$; (b) $X$ without antifields with $sX=0$ ⇒ $X=\sum_jc_jO^{\rm GI}_j+s\Lambda$. It is $H(s)$, not $H(s|d)$, because the insertions are unintegrated. `\uses{def:appM-alien, lem:prelim-brst-nilpotent}`. Proof: cited with sketch (Koszul–Tate differential with $H_k(\delta)=0$; longitudinal differential: $H(\gamma)$ = invariant polynomials of $F,\psi,\bar\psi$ and covariant derivatives times ghost primitives; $(\bar c,B)$ contractible) — `Henneaux:1993jn`, `Barnich:2000zw`, `Piguet:1995er`, `Joglekar:1975nu`, `Kluberg-Stern:1975ebk`.
- **引理 `lem:appM-lbc-formal` — 形式维数下逐圈的定域 BRST 上同调** (数学). Rescale all fields, $\tilde\phi=g_0\phi$, so that $S=g_0^{-2}\tilde S[\tilde\phi]$ and the rescaled BRST operator $\tilde s$, the equation-of-motion ideal $\tilde{\mathcal E}$ (generated by $\partial^\alpha\delta S/\delta\phi$) and the gauge-invariant (GI) monomials are $g_0$-independent; a connected hard subgraph with $E$ soft legs and $L$ loops carries $g_0^{2L+E-2}$, so the $L$-loop part has total weight $W=2-2L$ (weight grading = loop grading). Let $V^g$ be the finite-dimensional $\mathbb Q$-space of formal-$D$ polynomials in $\tilde\phi$ of given four-dimensional dimension, ghost number $g$ and tensor type (indices contracted with $g$, $\hat q$ and $\gamma^{[r]}$ of all ranks), $K=\{X\in V^0:\tilde sX\in\tilde{\mathcal E}\}$ and $\mathcal L={\rm GI}+\tilde sV^{-1}+\tilde{\mathcal E}$. Then $K=\mathcal L$, and for $X\in K$ of loop order $L$ the GI part is $\sum_j\gamma_jg_0^{k_j+2L-2}G_j(\phi)$ with non-negative exponents. `\uses{def:appM-alien, thm:appM-local-cohomology}`. Proof: full — $K\supset\mathcal L$ and both are $D$-independent ($\tilde s$ creates no self-contractions); specialization $D\to n$ is injective on $V$ for **even** $n\ge n_0$ (second fundamental theorem for O($n$); the $\gamma^{[r]}$, $r\le n$, are independent; for odd $n$ the top element is central); covariant elements of $\tilde{\mathcal E}$, GI and $\tilde s(\cdot)$ in dimension $n$ are specializations (averaging over Pin($n$), first fundamental theorem); local BRST cohomology in dimension $n$ (`Barnich:2000zw` Thm 7.1, Lemma 8.1, §§8.3, 8.6, valid in any dimension; `Henneaux:1995ex` §3; `Barnich:1999cy` App.) gives $K(n)=\mathcal L(n)$; non-identity colour-singlet GI monomials have $k_j\ge2$ factors $\tilde F,\tilde\psi,\tilde{\bar\psi}$. A new argument for a standard step (no novelty marker).
- **注 `rem:appM-joglekar-lee` — Joglekar–Lee 混合定理的结构** (no tag). Pointer to `prop:appJ-local-operators` (App J; gauge-invariant operators mix only into gauge-invariant ⊕ BRST-exact ⊕ EOM operators, block-triangularly) with the proof sketch: BRST-invariant source $\rho$; quantum action principle and absence of anomalies ⇒ the generating functional satisfies the master equation; $\mathcal S_\Gamma\Gamma_\rho=0$; induction in loops with DR locality; `thm:appM-local-cohomology`(a); block-triangularity via the source of $\Xi$. Literature `Joglekar:1975nu`, `Joglekar:1976eb`, `Joglekar:1976pe`, `Kluberg-Stern:1974iel`, `Kluberg-Stern:1974nmx`, `DixonTaylor1974`.
- **引理 `lem:appM-alien-vanish` — 外来算符的物理矩阵元为零（非前向或红外正规化）** [R, R_PT]. （$R_{\rm PT}$ …）（本引理只涉及部分子态。）(a) EOM operators: by the Schwinger–Dyson identity $\langle T[X\cdot\delta S/\delta\phi](z)\prod_k\phi_k(y_k)\rangle=i\sum_k(\pm)\delta^4(z-y_k)\langle TX(y_k)\prod_{l\ne k}\phi_l\rangle$ (the $\delta^4(0)$ term vanishes in DR), their matrix elements between on-shell partonic states vanish after LSZ **for non-zero momentum transfer, or with IR-regulated external legs (massive, or off-shell followed by the limit)**; at zero momentum transfer with regulated legs the vanishing follows from counting (two LSZ factors $(p^2-m^2)^2$ against at most one pole). (b) BRST-exact operators: $\langle\beta|s\Lambda|\alpha\rangle=i\langle\beta|[Q_B,\Lambda\}|\alpha\rangle=0$ for physical states (`KugoOjima1979`). `\uses{def:appM-alien, thm:prelim-slavnov-taylor}`. Proof: full. Surpass: ERR-M24 (the reference claimed "including forward" with an imprecise reason).
- **注 `rem:appM-forward-aliens` — 前向在壳胶子矩阵元的红外微妙之处** (no tag). At zero momentum transfer with massless on-shell gluons in DR the naive argument fails through IR singularities: Hamberg–van Neerven puzzle (`Hamberg:1991qt`) resolved by Collins–Scalise (`Collins:1994ee`); modern all-loop alien counterterms (`Falcioni:2022fdm`, `Gehrmann:2023ksf`). One-loop on-shell renormalization is safe; beyond one loop off-shell calculations need the alien operators. Precision (verification of R-M24): the explicit forward counterexample of `Collins:1994ee` concerns a BRST-exact alien operator; for equation-of-motion operators the forward on-shell massless case is simply **not covered** by `lem:appM-alien-vanish` — never claim that it fails. For forward on-shell massless parton targets with the physical polarization average, contracted alien **tree** vertices vanish (EOM vertices $\propto p^2,p_a$; $B$ legs $\propto p_a$; no external ghosts) — the step used in `cor:appM-forward-ope`; it says nothing about off-shell or off-forward matrix elements.

Content (v2.3, after the X3 verification): **(B2) ≡ (Eε)** — in bare DR at fixed generic $\varepsilon$ (any $\xi_0$, $B$ off shell, no $\gamma_5$, D-dimensional algebra), for one composite spectator $Z=s\phi$ ($\phi$ an elementary field) the large-$q$ expansion $\langle\mathcal J(q)\,Z\,\Phi\rangle=\sum_{d_O\le a}C_O\langle O\,Z\,\Phi\rangle+\sum_{O'}C^Z_{O'}(q;p_Z)\langle O'\,\Phi\rangle+\mathcal R'$ holds, with the coefficients $C_O$ of the expansion without $Z$ (`prop:dis-ope-euclid`), **merged coefficients** $C^Z_{O'}$ (hard subgraphs containing the $Z$ vertex) polynomial in $p_Z$, all coefficients graded-homogeneous, and $\mathcal R'=O(|q|^{1-a}\ln^k|q|)$. **(B1)** is retired (the name is not reused): its Ward identities hold exactly in DR and its contact-term clause is not needed. The earlier (B2), without merged terms, is not the correct generalization of the Euclidean expansion: the merged terms turn $sX_d=0$ into $sX_d\in\mathcal E$ (`thm:appM-brst-reduction`). `\uses{def:appM-alien}`.

The reference's conditional proposition is valid; its error was to call the old (B2) "the direct generalization" of the Euclidean expansion. No novelty is claimed (`Joglekar:1976pe`, read at abstract level). Content grade [A] (through (Eε)).

### M.7 `sec:appM-forward` 固定阶的全自旋求和 (1.5 pp)

- **引理 `lem:appM-forward-forests` — 前向 2-森林与 Symanzik 多项式** [R, R_PT]. （$R_{\rm PT}$ …）（本引理只涉及部分子态。）For a forward Compton graph with external momenta $p$ at $P_1$, $-p$ at $P_2$, $q$ at $J_1$, $-q$ at $J_2\ne J_1$ and $p^2=0$: $\mathcal F=Q^2(\hat F_0+\omega\hat F_1)$ with $\hat F_0=\sum_{T:\,c_q\ne0}\alpha^{E\setminus T}$ and $\hat F_1=-\sum_Tc_pc_q\alpha^{E\setminus T}$ (sums over spanning 2-forests $T$; $c_p,c_q\in\{0,\pm1\}$); every monomial of $\hat F_1$ occurs in $\hat F_0$ and has a coefficient of modulus $\le1$. `\uses{def:dis-compton}`. Proof: full ($-s_T=Q^2(c_q^2-c_pc_q\omega)$ for each 2-forest). Elementary.
- **引理 `lem:appM-newton` — Newton 多面体控制与 Taylor 级数** (数学). Let $\mathcal G_\lambda=\mathcal U+\hat F_0+\lambda\hat F_1$ with $\hat F_1$ dominated by $\hat F_0$ as in `lem:appM-forward-forests`, $P={\rm Newt}(\mathcal U+\hat F_0)$ full-dimensional and $|\lambda|\le r<1$. (a) $\int_{\mathbb R^N_+}\alpha^{s-1}g\,\mathcal G_\lambda^{-c}$ and all Taylor-term integrals (numerator $g\hat F_1^n$, exponent $c+n$) converge on a common open set of exponents; (b) there $I(\lambda)=\sum_n\lambda^nI_n$, absolutely; (c) the candidate poles of the meromorphic continuation are $\lambda$-independent, and $\frac1{n!}\partial^n_\lambda I|_{\lambda=0}=I_n$ after continuation. `\uses{lem:appM-forward-forests}`. Proof: full — the coefficients lie in $|\arg|\le\arcsin r$, so `Schultka:2018nrs` Thm 3.1 applies, and $s+m\in c\,{\rm int}P+nP\subset(c+n)\,{\rm int}P$; $\sum_n|\binom{-c}n|r^n\le(1-r)^{-|c|}$ and $|\hat F_1|\le\mathcal G_0$, then Tonelli–Fubini; on the cubes of a cubical decomposition of the orthant $\mathcal G_\lambda=x^{m_\sigma}(f_{\sigma,0}+\lambda f_{\sigma,1})$ with real part $\ge(1-r)f_{\sigma,0}>0$; Gel'fand–Shilov continuation and the identity theorem. Standard tools.
- **引理 `lem:appM-matroid` — 拟阵形式与维数正规化的可容许性** (数学). Let $G_0=G+e_q$ ($e_q$ joining $J_1$, $J_2$), with $N$ lines and $L$ loops. (a) $\hat F_0=\mathcal U(G/\{J_1{=}J_2\})$ and $\mathcal U(G_0)=x_q\mathcal U(G)+\hat F_0$, so ${\rm Newt}(\mathcal U+\hat F_0)$ is the base polytope of the dual matroid $M^*(G_0)$ (after dropping $x_q=L+1-\sum x_e$); (b) its dimension is $N+1-c(M(G_0))$, so it is full-dimensional iff $G_0$ is loopless and 2-connected; (c) the facet normals are $e_e$ ($d=0$), $-\mathbb 1$ ($d=-(L+1)$), $-\mathbb 1_F$ ($d=-r^*(F)\le-1$) and $\mathbb 1_{E\setminus F'}$ ($d=L+1-r^*(F'\cup e_q)\ge1$), so $d=0$ only for the coordinate facets; (d) for ${\rm Re}\,a_e>0$, polynomial numerators, Tarasov shifts, Taylor terms and all $\omega\in\mathcal C=\mathbb C\setminus((-\infty,-1]\cup[1,\infty))$, the only $D$-independent candidate poles are $a_e\in-\mathbb N_0$. `\uses{lem:appM-forward-forests}`. Proof: full — deletion–contraction; (b)–(d) are the $q$-only generic-Euclidean case of `Schultka:2018nrs` §4 (Def. 4.3, Thm 4.15, Props 4.17, 4.29, 4.31, Cor. 4.18, Thm 4.32), with Whitney's theorem for 2-connectivity; see also `Borinsky:2020rqs` Thm 32 and `Arkani-Hamed:2022cqe`; the coefficient condition holds for all $\omega\in\mathcal C$ because $1=\frac{(1+\omega)+(1-\omega)}2$. Checks: X3 scripts f1, f3 (21 + 1028 graphs, 0 failures). Known in substance.
- **定理 `thm:appM-forward-expansion` — 前向在壳 DR 振幅的逐图展开定理** [R, R_PT]. （$R_{\rm PT}$：逐图、逐阶严格。）（本定理只涉及部分子态。）Let $\Gamma$ be a connected graph of the amputated forward Compton amplitude of a massless on-shell parton ($p^2=0$) with two current insertions, in dimensional plus analytic regularization (line powers $a_e$). Bridges carrying $\pm p$ are external-leg corrections (removed by amputation; the DR LSZ factor is 1); zero-momentum bridges are gluons whose non-target side carries a single adjoint index, so they vanish by colour graph by graph; bridges carrying $\pm q$ cannot occur. The amplitude is defined by its Lee–Pomeransky/Speer parametric integral at $p^2=0$ (`LeePomeransky2013`): for real $|\omega|<1$ all coefficients are positive and $\mathcal F>0$ on the orthant, so the $(\mathcal F-i0)$ prescription is immaterial and the integral equals the $i\epsilon$ momentum integral; elsewhere it is defined by continuation. Then: **(F1)** for $\omega\in\mathcal C$ the integral converges on an $\omega$-independent open set of regulator values and continues meromorphically with $\omega$-independent candidate poles; every Laurent coefficient (in $\varepsilon$, at $a_e=1$) is holomorphic on $\mathcal C$; **(F2)** for $|\omega|<1$ each Laurent coefficient equals $\sum_n\omega^nI^{[k]}_n$, the sum of the naive Taylor terms (replace $p\to\lambda p$ and expand the integrand in $\lambda$), absolutely and locally uniformly; **(F3)** if $G_0$ is degenerate, both sides vanish. `\uses{def:dis-compton, lem:appM-forward-forests, lem:appM-newton, lem:appM-matroid}`. Proof: full — Tarasov's relation (tensor integrals → scalar integrals in shifted dimensions with shifted powers) and `lem:appM-forward-forests`; for ${\rm Im}\,\omega\ne0$ the coefficients $\{1,1\pm\omega\}$ lie in an open half-plane, so `Schultka:2018nrs` Thm 3.1 applies, with joint holomorphy on the cubes; (F2) by `lem:appM-newton` and the pointwise equality of parametric and momentum-space Taylor terms (Schwinger–Gauss), restricted to DR by `lem:appM-matroid`(d); (F3) by scaling invariance. Checks (X3 scripts): f1/f3, f2 (`ex:appM-forward-triangle`), and the independent reviewer checks rv21_box (box, all powers free), rv2_ladder2 (two-loop ladder), rv32_triangle. **Status (print):** 本书给出的严格证明 of the **analytic step** of the method of projectors. Verified literature: `Larin:1996wd` §2 (checked) applies the projector "to the integrands of all Feynman diagrams", with a remark on the rearrangement of infrared and ultraviolet divergences, and gives no proof of this step; the earlier papers of the method were not checked, and nothing is claimed about their content beyond their use of the method; four reviewer INSPIRE searches found no prior proof. Closest prior result found: `Semenova:2018cwy` §7, Prop. 6, which — like `Jantzen2011` — does not cover this case. The novelty check (Tkachov's papers, `Smirnov2002`, Schultka's §4, `Borinsky:2020rqs`, `Arkani-Hamed:2022cqe`, `NilssonPassare2013`) is open (Ch25), so 「本书新结果」 is **not** printed. The identification of the Taylor coefficients with $\overline{\rm MS}$ OPE coefficients is `cor:appM-forward-ope` ([A]). Slot X3e: PASS per graph; `asm:appM-forward` is only reduced, never 「已解除」.
- **例 `ex:appM-forward-triangle` — 前向三角图：精确的 Taylor 系数** . One-loop forward triangle with free line powers $a_1,a_2,a_3$, $a=\sum_ia_i$: $I=\frac{\Gamma(a-\frac D2)}{\prod_i\Gamma(a_i)}(Q^2)^{\frac D2-a}B(\tfrac D2-a_2,\tfrac D2-a_1-a_3)\,B(a_1,a_3)\,{}_2F_1(a-\tfrac D2,a_1;a_1+a_3;\omega)$; its $\omega^n$ coefficients equal the naive Taylor terms identically in $(a_1,a_2,a_3,D)$; at $a_i=1$ the poles are $-1/((n+1)\varepsilon)$; direct quadrature at six complex $\omega$, four of them outside the unit disk, agrees to $10^{-10}$. `\uses{thm:appM-forward-expansion}`. Check: X3 script f2 (D).
- **引理 `lem:appM-t2-projector` — D 维中 $T_2$ 的投影与前向振幅的全纯性** [R, R_PT]. （$R_{\rm PT}$ …）（本引理只涉及部分子态。）Quark targets are averaged with $\frac12\slashed p$, gluon targets with $d_{ab}/(D-2)$, $d_{ab}=-g_{ab}+(p_aq_b+q_ap_b)/\nu-q^2p_ap_b/\nu^2$ ($d\cdot p=d\cdot q=0$, ${\rm tr}\,d=2-D$). (a) For transverse $T\in{\rm span}\{g,pp,pq,qp,qq\}$: $T_2=\frac{Q^4[(D-1)S_1-(\nu^2/Q^2)S_2]}{(D-2)\nu^3}$ with $S_1=p_\mu p_\nu T^{\mu\nu}$, $S_2=g_{\mu\nu}T^{\mu\nu}$; (b) quark target: each naive term is transverse and of the form $a\nu^ng+b\nu^{n-2}pp+c\nu^{n-1}pq+c'\nu^{n-1}qp+e\nu^nqq$; transversality gives $c=c'=b/Q^2$, $a=eQ^2-b/Q^2$, and the projector returns $b\nu^{n-1}$, so the $\omega^{-3},\dots,\omega^0$ terms cancel for every $n$: $T^{(q)}_2$ is holomorphic on $\mathcal C$, $O(\omega)$, equal to its naive Taylor series, and odd after summing crossed graphs; at tree level in $D$ dimensions $T_2=4\omega/(1-\omega^2)$, $T_1=2\omega^2/(1-\omega^2)$; (c) gluon target: $T=H_0+H_1/\nu+H_2/\nu^2$, with `thm:appM-forward-expansion` applied to each $H_k$: meromorphic on $\mathcal C$, holomorphic on $\mathcal C\setminus\{0\}$, with the naive Laurent expansion; regularity at $\omega=0$ is `cor:appM-forward-ope` ([A]) or `lem:appM-gluon-regularity`. `\uses{thm:appM-forward-expansion, def:dis-compton}`. - **推论 `cor:appM-forward-ope` — 每阶的前向在壳部分子 OPE** [A]. (a) For $|\omega|<1$, at every order and Laurent order, $T^{\mu\nu}_j=\sum_OC^{\mu\nu}_O\langle j|[O]|j\rangle$ for an on-shell massless parton target $j$ (physical polarization average); only twist-2 gauge-invariant operators contribute, $A^{(n)}_{i/j}=\sum Z\cdot{\rm tree}$, and $T^{(j)}_2=4\sum_{n\ {\rm even}}\omega^{n-1}\sum_iC^{(n)}_{2,i}A^{(n)}_{i/j}$; $T^{(g)}_2$ is regular at $\omega=0$; (b) for $|q|\ge4p^0$, uniformly in the Euclidean direction, $|T_j-\sum_{d_O\le N}C_O\langle j|[O]|j\rangle|\le C|q|^{1-N}(1+\ln|q|)^k$ — the content of `asm:appM-forward`. `\uses{thm:appM-forward-expansion, lem:appM-matroid, lem:appM-t2-projector, lem:appM-ne, prop:dis-ope-euclid, thm:appM-brst-reduction, prop:appJ-local-operators, lem:appM-alien-vanish}`. - **假设 `asm:appM-oswi` — 前向在壳胶子振幅的 Ward 恒等式** [\tagA]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. Content: for the amputated forward on-shell gluon Compton amplitude $M_{ab}$ at each order in DR, $p^aM_{ab}\varepsilon^b=0=\varepsilon^aM_{ab}p^b$ for all $\varepsilon$ with $\varepsilon\cdot p=0$ (including $\varepsilon=p$); equivalently $p^aM_{ab}\propto p_b$ (the BRST form, the ghost amplitude being inside the proportionality factor). `\uses{def:dis-compton, def:prelim-brst}`.
- **引理 `lem:appM-gluon-regularity` — 由在壳 Ward 恒等式得到胶子靶在 $\omega=0$ 的正则性** [R, R_cond]. （$R_{\rm cond}$ …）前提：\cref{asm:appM-oswi}。（本引理只涉及部分子态。）The naive Taylor terms of $d^{ab}M_{ab}$ are polynomial in $\omega$; hence $T^{(g)}_2$ is regular at $\omega=0$, without `thm:appM-brst-reduction`. `\uses{asm:appM-oswi, thm:appM-forward-expansion, lem:appM-t2-projector}`. Proof: full — expand the Ward identity termwise (`thm:appM-forward-expansion`(F2)): $p^aM_{n,ab}\varepsilon^b=0$; by the first fundamental theorem $p^aM_{n,ab}=\alpha_np_b$ and $M_{n,ab}p^b=\alpha'_np_a$ with polynomial $\alpha_n,\alpha'_n$; with $p^2=0$, $d^{ab}M_{n,ab}=-g^{ab}M_{n,ab}+\alpha_n+\alpha'_n$, which is transverse (the electromagnetic Ward identity has no contact terms for neutral gluons); apply `lem:appM-t2-projector`(b). Content grade [A]; a new conditional form (the Ward identity at theorem level is open, Ch25).

### M.8 `sec:appM-np` 非微扰层 (5 pp)

Opening paragraph: obstacles — no four-dimensional non-abelian gauge theory has been constructed (Wightman/Osterwalder–Schrader; Yang–Mills existence and mass gap is a Clay problem; partial results: Bałaban's ultraviolet stability for lattice Yang–Mills (`Balaban:1985yy`, `Balaban:1989ay`), Magnen–Rivasseau–Sénéor with an infrared cutoff (`Magnen:1992wv`)); composite fields need point splitting, which presupposes OPE-type asymptotics; perturbation theory is not summable (renormalons, instantons), so "every order" implies nothing non-perturbative and at most asymptoticity can be hoped for (two-dimensional Gross–Neveu: Schwinger functions are Borel sums, `Feldman:1986ax`, `Gawedzki:1985ez`).

- **表 `tab:appM-axioms` — 每条公理/假设在何处被使用** (new table, owner App M): rows (W1) locality + spectral condition → `lem:appM-forward-tube` (forward-tube holomorphy), edge of the wedge; (W2) spectral condition in the target superselection sector → support of $\nu_Q$ on $[1,\infty)$, `lem:appM-positivity`; isolation → Haag–Ruelle states only (`Haag:1958vt`); (W3) temperedness → Vladimirov bound, $Q$-independent $A,B$; (W4) covariant retarded extension → definition of $T_2$; polynomial ambiguity → finitely many low $t_n$; `asm:intro-composite` → twist-2 basis, RG, light-ray operators (`thm:pdf-moments-local`); `asm:intro-np-ope` → (OPE1) for hadrons, covariance, chiral suppression (`lem:dis-ope-segment`); `asm:intro-af-coeff` → asymptotic $\overline{\rm MS}$ coefficients (`thm:dis-moments-np`(i)); `asm:intro-growth` → $n<n_0$ (`prop:dis-low-moments`). Commentary only: the assumptions are **stated once** in Ch1 (WRITER_SPEC_v2 §4.4 item 5). Correction note (ERR-M25): (W2) is formulated in the superselection sector of the target's conserved flavour numbers (false in the chiral limit and for $m_u\ne m_d$ if formulated for the whole baryon-number-1 sector); massive light quarks are assumed and reconciled with the massless $\overline{\rm MS}$ coefficients by treating $m_q^2/Q^2$ and chiral-odd $m_qM/Q^2$ terms as power corrections.
- **引理 `lem:appM-forward-tube` — 前向管全纯性与与 $Q$ 无关的增长指数** [R, R_cond]. （$R_{\rm cond}$ …）前提：\cref{asm:intro-wightman}。非微扰地位：见前提（MA0）。The Fourier transform $\tilde R^{\mu\nu}(q)$ of the retarded commutator of (W4) is holomorphic in the forward tube ${\rm Im}\,q\in V_+$ with $|\tilde R^{\mu\nu}(q)|\le C(1+|q|)^a\big(1+{\rm dist}({\rm Im}\,q,\partial V_+)^{-b}\big)$ (Vladimirov-type bound; `Streater:1989vi`, `Jost:1965yxu`; `Vladimirov2002`, 位置待核实). With the parametrization $q^0=w$, $\mathbf q=(0,0,s)$, $s^2=w^2+Q^2$ (rest frame) one has ${\rm Im}\,q\in V_+$ and ${\rm dist}\ge w_2Q^2/(2\sqrt2(|w|^2+Q^2))$ ($w_2={\rm Im}\,w$); consequently $|T_2(\omega)|\le C_Q(1+|\omega|)^A|{\rm Im}\,\omega|^{-B}$ with $A,B$ **independent of $Q$** and $C_Q$ locally bounded. `\uses{asm:intro-wightman, def:dis-compton}`. Proof: full given the tube theorem (the geometric bound re-derived; reader check: 20 000 random points, 0 failures).
- **引理 `lem:appM-hatP-zero` — $\hat P=0$ 点的不变量论证** [R, R_def]. （$R_{\rm def}$ …）At $w=iQ$ ($\hat P=0$, where the projector of $T_2$ is singular) expand in complex $\mathbf k$: $\tilde R^{ij}=a\,\delta^{ij}+b\,k^ik^j$, so $T_2=(Q^4/\nu)(b+a/Q^2)$ is analytic there. `\uses{def:dis-compton}`. Proof: full.
- **引理 `lem:appM-curved-approach` — 沿弯曲路径逼近的边界值** (数学). Let $f$ be holomorphic on $X+i(\Gamma\cap B_\gamma)$ ($X\subset\mathbb R^m$ open, $\Gamma\ne\mathbb R^m$ an open convex cone) with $|f(x+iy)|\le C|y|^{-N}$ and distributional boundary value $f_0$; let $\Theta_\eta:X'\Subset X\to\mathbb C^m$ be smooth with ${\rm Im}\,\Theta_\eta\in(\Gamma'\setminus0)\cap B_{\gamma/2}$ for a closed cone $\Gamma'$ with $\Gamma'\setminus0\subset\Gamma$, and $\Theta_\eta\to{\rm id}$ in $C^\infty$ as $\eta\to0$. Then $\int f(\Theta_\eta(x))\varphi(x)\,dx\to\langle f_0,\varphi\rangle$ for $\varphi\in C^\infty_c(X')$. `% uses: none`. Proof: full — a routine extension of the proof of the boundary-value theorem of `Hormander2003` (Thm 3.1.15; 位置待核实 in the reprint): Taylor's formula at $s=1$ for $s\mapsto f(z+isY)$, $Y\in\Gamma$, gives $f=\sum_{k\le N}\frac{(-i)^k}{k!}L^kf_Y+L^{N+1}H$ with $L=Y\cdot\partial_z$ and $H$ continuous up to the edge; $(L^{N+1}H)\circ\Theta_\eta=(a_\eta\cdot\partial_x)^{N+1}(H\circ\Theta_\eta)$ with $a_\eta=(D\Theta_\eta)^{-1}Y\to Y$; integrate by parts; straight approaches identify the limit with $f_0$. Numerical check: X3 script rv32_bv. Standard (proof supplied).
- **引理 `lem:appM-positivity` — 不连续性的正性（$Q^2$ 抹平）** [R, R_cond]. （$R_{\rm cond}$ …）前提：\cref{asm:intro-wightman}。非微扰地位：见前提（MA0）。${\rm Disc}\,T_2=T_2(\omega+i0)-T_2(\omega-i0)=4\pi i\,\nu_Q$ on $(0,\infty)$ with $\nu_Q\ge0$ supported on $[1,\infty)$, $\nu_Q(d\omega)=F_2(1/\omega)\,d\omega$ (elastic point included), $\int x^{n-2}F_2\,dx=\int\omega^{-n}d\nu_Q$; positivity from spectral measures ($F_1\ge0$, $F_2\ge\nu F_1/\hat P^2\ge0$); the restriction of four-dimensional distributional boundary values to the one-dimensional slice at fixed $Q^2$ (needed both for positivity and for the edge-of-the-wedge step) is justified for **every** $Q^2>0$: $K$-fold primitives in $w$ ($K>B$) give slice boundary values, weakly continuous in $Q^2$; on test functions supported in the space-like region away from $\mathbf q=0$, SO(3) averaging turns the four-dimensional approach into the curved approach $\Theta_\eta=(x+i\eta,\,s+\eta^2-2ix\eta)$, covered by finitely many patches with fixed closed subcones (`lem:appM-curved-approach`); weak continuity then transfers positivity and support (`Epstein1960` for the one-dimensional edge of the wedge; repairs ERR-m24/R5 E9). `\uses{asm:intro-wightman, lem:appM-forward-tube, prop:dis-W-structure, lem:appM-curved-approach}`. Proof: full.
- **引理 `lem:appM-green` — 几乎解析延拓与 Green 公式：不连续性测度的增长** (数学). If $F$ is holomorphic in ${\rm Im}\,\omega>0$ with $|F(\omega)|\le C(1+|\omega|)^A|{\rm Im}\,\omega|^{-B}$ and its boundary value has imaginary part the positive measure $\nu$ on $[1,\infty)$, then $\nu([1,R])\le C'R^{A+1}$. `% uses: none`. Proof: full (almost-analytic extension $\tilde\chi$ of a cutoff with $|\bar\partial\tilde\chi|=O(|{\rm Im}\,\omega|^{B})$, Green's formula; almost-analytic extensions as in `Hormander2003`, 位置待核实).

- **注 `rem:appM-svz` — 实用 OPE、基的重排与重整子吸收** (no tag). The practical (SVZ) OPE with a factorization scale $\Lambda\ll\mu_F\ll Q$ and a hard cutoff has power-divergent mixing ($\mu_F^2O_2$ in $O_4(\mu_F)$), is routing dependent and gauge breaking unless a gauge-invariant smooth cutoff is found (pointer `rem:power-practical-ope`, Ch21); rearrangement freedom $O'_i=O_i+\sum_{d_j<d_i}\kappa_{ij}\Lambda^{d_i-d_j}O_j$ leaves asymptotic expansions unchanged and makes twist-2 coefficients meaningful only to relative $O(\Lambda^2/Q^2\ln^kQ)$ unless normalized non-perturbatively (pointer `prop:power-rearrangement`, Ch21; rearranging only twist ≥ 4 changes twist-2 coefficients by $o(\alpha_s^K)$, so `thm:dis-moments-np` is unaffected); renormalon absorption into twist 4 has exactly two conjectural ingredients (Borel continuation along $\mathbb R_+$ near the singularities; factorization of the residue with RG-matched $\alpha_s$ dependence), verified at large $\beta_0$ and in the large-$N$ O($N$) σ-model (`Beneke:1998eq`, `David:1982qv`, `Novikov:1984ac`); general case `conj:power-renormalon-ht`.
- **注 `rem:appM-supporting` — 支持性的严格结果** (no tag). Convergence of the OPE at finite distance in massive and massless $\varphi^4_4$ at fixed loop order (`Hollands:2011gf`, `Holland:2014pna`); all-order bounds for gauge-invariant correlators in Yang–Mills (`Frob:2015uqy`); existence and recursion of the OPE in Yang–Mills (`Frob:2016mzv`, preprint), associativity and recursive construction (`Holland:2015tia`, `Holland:2014ifa`); OPE from phase-space properties in AQFT (`Bostelmann:2005rr`); curved spacetime (`Hollands:2006ag`, `Hollands:2007zg`); Borel summability in the Gross–Neveu model (`Feldman:1986ax`, `Gawedzki:1985ez`); lattice short-distance comparisons are evidence, not proof. Status for QCD with quarks per frontier/others §2.7 (convergence [C]).

## Appendix N — Collins 减除法的精确形式 / The precise form of Collins' subtraction method

`\label{app:appN}` · `appN_subtraction.tex` · **24 pp** · appendix (proofs) · written **first** among M/N/O

**Purpose.** Turn "the subtraction step" of every factorization proof into (i) a deliberately elementary conditional theorem (`thm:appN-subtraction`: Collins conditions (CS1)–(CS3) ⇒ remainder power suppressed in an integral norm uniform in $\varepsilon$), (ii) the exact combinatorics that reduce (CS1)(CS2) to grouped power counting (chains, pairing, product formula), (iii) explicit idempotent approximators with their $i0$ and a complete error table, (iv) process-by-process statements with their inputs listed by label (DIS, SIA, thrust, DY, TMD, exclusive), (v) the assembled factorization structure `thm:appN-structure`, and (vi) a complete one-loop example with the exact remainder and a two-loop ladder that shows why grouping is necessary. The numbered inputs (`asm:appN-*`) are exactly the [A]-level content of Collins 2011 ch. 10 and of CSS, now named one by one.
